summary: The customer called in frustrated because their new router was not working after trying to set it up for two hours. The agent calmly guided the customer to power-cycle the device and connect to the Wi-Fi network using the password printed underneath the router. The issue was successfully resolved, and the customer apologized for their initial frustration and thanked the agent.
